article.title: How to eat well in Berlin
article.excerpt: Paris has dozens of restaurants which are better than any in Berlin, and then hundreds more better than the rest. Yet it may be the case that you have, overall, a better food life in Berlin than in Paris. Berlin has a weak reputation among foodies, but culinary life in the city is much improved.
